model_selection: Keep V4's development-only checkpoint selection unchanged to isolate the sampler. Apply the stricter murmur-focus promotion checks after native conversion. Never choose or tune weights or thresholds using regression results.

recording_and_linked_person_checks: Correct absent outputs do not decrease
promotion.improvement: At least one additional correctly detected positive recording or linked person without violating the checks. PASCAL has no verified patient IDs; use recording-only comparisons and label person-level evidence unavailable.
promotion.controls: All existing native silence/short/clipping/invalid-probability checks pass; report noise-control errors separately.
promotion.conversion: Native inference and PyTorch on identical waveforms agree within .001 maximum probability difference, including real public development audio.
promotion.freeze: Freeze selected weights, model package files, reader, native executable, evaluator, cohort and .60 rule before regression scoring. Do not change the app unless all comparisons support promotion.

reliability.evidence: Previously untouched, clinician-labeled, representative phone recordings from independent people and relevant recording environments; predeclared protocol, confidence intervals and subgroup results. Reused development/regression scores cannot satisfy this requirement.
